La vista Garage organizza le regolazioni: Garage view organizes the settings read from the file. Corner weights, cross weight, actual ride heights, hot pressures, temperatures and wear are not inferred from preload or other settings. They require simulator results. Reference screenshots are not paired with a specific STO file.
Concetto documentato; associazione al ca: Documented concept; association with the field is based on its name, and garage conversion is unverified.
Pressione iniziale del pneumatico quando: Initial tire pressure when the car is loaded. It is distinct from hot pressure after a run.
Forza necessaria per una variazione di l: Force required for a change in spring length. This setting is not a measurement of actual ride height.
Regolazione del precarico statico. Nel m: Static preload adjustment. In the NextGen manual, the collar affects corner weight and ride height; its offset is not ground clearance.
Resistenza dell’ammortizzatore all’accor: Resistance to damper shortening at low shaft speed. Low speed refers to suspension motion, not vehicle speed.
Resistenza all’accorciamento rapido dell: Resistance to fast shaft compression, such as over bumps or curbs. The internal number is not automatically converted into clicks.
Resistenza all’allungamento dell’ammorti: Resistance to damper extension during slow suspension motion. The internal scale remains separate from garage clicks.
Resistenza all’allungamento rapido dello: Resistance to rapid shaft extension, often after an impact. Reading the STO does not measure the dynamic suspension response.
Regola la forma della risposta dell’ammo: Adjusts the shape of the damper response at high shaft speeds. It is distinct from the compression or rebound setting alone.
Il diametro contribuisce alla rigidezza: Diameter contributes to axle roll stiffness. The NextGen manual describes two options; a Soft/Firm selection is not inferred from the internal code alone.
Il manuale NextGen descrive posizioni P1: The NextGen manual describes positions P1–P5. Whether the STO number is zero-based or one-based is unverified, so the original index is preserved.
Collegare o scollegare la barra cambia i: Attaching or disconnecting the bar changes its contribution. The manual describes the control but does not prove the numeric encoding of each STO field.
Carico statico della barra nel garage. N: Static bar loading in the garage. It is not a direct measurement of cross weight and cannot determine it by itself.
Il manuale descrive la percentuale della: The manual describes the percentage of braking sent to the front. The internal field and its scale must be confirmed separately.
Il diametro della pompa modifica la risp: Master cylinder diameter changes pedal response. A serialized index is not a diameter in inches or millimeters.
Il manuale esprime lo spostamento della: The manual describes rack travel per steering-wheel revolution. The STO field scale is not inferred from the manual's example.
Il manuale descrive un disassamento ango: The manual describes an angular steering-wheel offset. The STO value is not assigned a degree scale without a demonstrated conversion.
Rapporto tra pignone e corona del differ: Ratio between differential pinion and ring gear. The internal index is not the actual ratio.
Precarico statico degli elementi di attr: Static preload on the differential friction elements. It is not a calculated locking value during driving.
Decoder verificato su due campioni sinte: Decoder checked against two synthetic samples. No personal files used.
Avvio del reader in corso. Se questo mes: Starting the reader. If this message stays visible, the script did not run. Download the complete HTML file and open it in an up-to-date desktop browser.
Valori leggibili, parametri divisi per a: Readable values, parameters grouped by car area, and changes from A to B.
Apri uno o due file STO: l’elaborazione: Open one or two STO files. Processing happens in your browser and your files stay on your device.
Ho creato STO Reader per rendere comode: I built STO Reader to make checking and comparing setups convenient, especially offline, without having to upload private setup values to external platforms, APIs or cloud storage.
I file selezionati vengono letti nella m: Selected files are read in browser memory. The tool does not send them to a server, persist them in browser storage, or use analytics, accounts or external translation services.
La pagina online serve a distribuire il: The online page distributes the tool. Its hosting provider receives normal page requests, but the tool does not send selected setups to it. To work without network requests, download the HTML file and open it locally, including after disconnecting from the Internet.
I report e i CSV esportati contengono ri: Exported reports and CSV files contain results from your setups; you decide whether to share them. The complete tool embeds its decoding logic and can be inspected.

Anteriore in alto · sinistra e destra da: Front at the top. Left and right are from the driver's seat. Uses the table's units; missing or duplicate fields are not inferred.
CSV, report e stampa seguono i filtri at: CSV, reports and printing use the current filters. The report contains setup values without the decoder or decoding constants.
Le etichette interpretano i nomi tecnici: Labels interpret technical field names. Converted units come from explicit field suffixes; equivalence with garage values has not been verified. Indices and settings remain internal codes. Original data is always available in the details.

La prima riga mostra il valore semplific: The first line shows the simplified or converted value, with the original number below. Δ means B minus A. If rounding hides a difference, the row stays highlighted and says so. The exact original difference remains available.
“Indice”, “impostazione” e “codice inter: An index, setting or internal code does not automatically represent garage clicks or values. Unknown parameters stay visible. Labels and groups interpret the field name.
Pressioni: Pa → bar/psi. Rigidità molle:: Pressure: Pa → bar/psi. Spring stiffness: N/m → N/mm or lbf/in. Lengths with explicit m suffixes → mm/in. Fuel fields with Kg suffixes → kg/lb. No angle or kg-to-liter conversion. These units come from field names; garage equivalence is still unverified.
Il confronto dei numeri originali è esat: Original numbers are compared exactly: 1.0 and 1.000000 are equal. Only displayed conversions are rounded. Duplicate parameters are matched by name and occurrence. Across different cars, identical names do not prove identical meaning.
STO Reader 0.4 · STO v3. Nessuna modific: STO Reader 0.4 · STO v3. No setup modifications. Equal parameters do not imply equal notes, metadata or binary trailers. The tool HTML embeds the decoder; exported reports contain only results. Independent project, not affiliated with iRacing.
